pieces.Text: You can choose to remember a particular fighting style, skill, proficiency, or feat for upt to one hour.  In addition, you may attempt to recall a single fighting style, skill, proficiency, or feat even after expending focus by making a successful Autohypnosis roll as a swift action (DC 15 + the number of rounds since witnessing the style, skill, proficiency, or feat).  You must currently have focus to use this ability.
